canonical_identifier_hashes.collision_rule: Exact canonical UTF-8 equality controls; same hash with different bytes is an integrity collision and rejects.

evolution: A semantic normalization change creates a new exact version/hash; retained records preserve their original binding.

r02_trim_dependency.scope: Only the edge-trim bytes/operation are shared; R02 TARGET_REP classification and R01 identifier grammars remain distinct.

relationship_comparison: EXACT_ES and EXACT_MFG compare exact canonical bytes under this exact contract binding. Relationship identity binds kind, both canonical identifiers, normalization contract version, and content SHA-256; fuzzy or cross-version equality is forbidden.

runtime_binding.failure_behavior: Unknown/unavailable version, stale binding, hash mismatch, or same version with different bytes rejects before relationship/evaluation append and persists no derived result.
